create.name: Ashanna Solaris
create.bio:
Ashanna Solaris has worked in the healing arts since 1990 and, with her long-time teaching partner Dana Dharma Devi, founded Clarity Breathwork, a gentle, feminine form of conscious connected breathing that the two have taught together for about thirty years. Her own grounding is in Light Body meditation, Reiki and energy work, ritual, dance and some study of Somatic Experiencing; before that she trained in theatre at New York University and later studied at the California Institute of Integral Studies. Dana, a flautist, composer and kirtan leader who has taught since the 1980s, brings live music, mantra and relationship work into the sessions.

The pair now live on Maui, Hawaii, where Ashanna sees private clients and holds retreats, and they run most of their programmes online as a graded path: an introductory video course, a longer intensive, practitioner training and a group-facilitator level, with an annual in-person season in Ubud, Bali. Ashanna also leads Chrysalis, a three-month rite of passage for women that mixes breath, meditation, ceremony and a short live retreat on Maui, and smaller online circles under the name Women with Wings. Many of their graduates now offer the method as certified practitioners.

courses.title: Online Level 1: Sacred Breath & Embodiment Video Course
courses.description: Recorded first level of the Clarity Breathwork path, worked through at home in your own time. It combines guided breath sessions with kirtan, Light Body meditations, movement and reflective exercises.

courses.title: Online Level 2 Healing Intensive
courses.description: The second level, taught live online in three-day blocks that recur through the year. It deepens personal breath practice and is the required step before practitioner training.

courses.title: Clarity Breathwork Practitioner Training (Level 3/4)
courses.description: Live online training for people who want to guide others in the method, spread over three modules in February, March and April 2027. Graduates go on towards certification as Clarity Breathwork practitioners.

courses.title: Professional Clarity Breathwork Certification Program (Levels 1–5)
courses.description: The full certification path from the first level through group facilitation, joined by application. Students can also sign up for single levels.

courses.title: Bali Clarity Breathwork Retreats and Trainings 2027
courses.description: A month of residential programmes in Ubud with both founders: an eight-day introductory intensive, then practitioner and group facilitator trainings that can be booked separately or together. The price shown is for the first intensive.

courses.title: Chrysalis: Women's Rite of Passage – Maui
courses.description: Ashanna's three-month journey for women, running from midwinter to the March equinox, with online ceremonies, weekly teachings, private sessions and a five-day gathering on Maui. An online-only option is also offered at a lower price.

courses.title: Return to the Temple: Coming Home to Yourself
courses.description: A two-hour live online circle for women led by Ashanna under her Women with Wings name, weaving breath, embodiment and ritual. Places are offered on a sliding scale.
